decisions.reason: The custom earmold for in-ear systems fits the firm's core audiology competence and costs little to keep on the market, and one year of results leaves its value uncertain, so the option stays open.

The individual EARsleeve has its own page and is made to order on the firm's existing production base, so keeping it is cheap while its potential with universal in-ear hearing systems is still unresolved.

The vacuum thermoforming unit extends the firm's established equipment line and has its own page, and nothing yet shows its value will not be realized, so the firm continues while uncertainty resolves.
